description: Showcase your KPIs with an intelligent and customizable display Metric is a simple yet powerful way to display key performance indicators (KPIs) in your Power BI reports. Designed for clarity and customization, Metric presents your KPI in a transparent or colored box, with its series name in a matching opaque box. The result is a sleek, modern visual that enhances the readability of your data. Unlike traditional KPI visuals, Metric allows for full control over alignment, color, transparency, and formatting. Whether you need a bold, centered number or a subtle inline metric, Metric adapts to your report’s style while ensuring your audience understands the data. Why choose Viz Data for Power BI? We design beautiful and highly functional custom visuals that seamlessly blend into your Power BI reports while maintaining the polish of PowerPoint and modern web design. Key Features and Benefits ⚡ Customize Units: Display values in thousands, millions or trillions using a custom divisor, or let the auto option intelligently abbreviate numbers. Set the precise number of decimals you need.
